name: tideline
description: macOS app that files older downloads into folders named for the day they arrived
author: Elio Struyf

scripts.sign: cd app && CODESIGN_IDENTITY="${CODESIGN_IDENTITY:-$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning | sed -n 's/.*"\(Developer ID Application: [^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1)}" ./build.sh --zip
scripts.notarize: cd app && CODESIGN_IDENTITY="${CODESIGN_IDENTITY:-$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning | sed -n 's/.*"\(Developer ID Application: [^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1)}" ./build.sh --notarize
scripts.release: cd app && CODESIGN_IDENTITY="${CODESIGN_IDENTITY:-$(security find-identity -v -p codesigning | sed -n 's/.*"\(Developer ID Application: [^"]*\)".*/\1/p' | head -1)}" ./build.sh --notarize
scripts.icon: cd app && swift Tools/make-icon.swift dist/AppIcon.iconset && open dist/AppIcon.iconset
